Class SecureCabinetOrderItem

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.customerportal.model.json.creators.SecureCabinetOrderItem
public class SecureCabinetOrderItem extends Object
Cabinet configuration on a secure cabinet order (OrderItem schema). All fields are required by the API: drawCapacity (combined power draw in kVA, in 0.5 increments), fabricPort (include a primary Fabric port), numberOfCabinets, cabinetDimensions and pdus (install Equinix-recommended PDUs).

    • SecureCabinetOrderItem

      public SecureCabinetOrderItem(Double drawCapacity, Boolean fabricPort, Integer numberOfCabinets, CabinetDimensions cabinetDimensions, Boolean pdus)
      Creates a secure cabinet order item.
      Parameters:
      drawCapacity - the combined power draw of all cabinets, in kVA (required)
      fabricPort - whether a primary Fabric port should be included (required)
      numberOfCabinets - the number of ordered cabinets (required)
      cabinetDimensions - the cabinet dimensions (required)
      pdus - whether Equinix-recommended PDUs should be installed (required)
